name: Lovable
description: Lovable lets agents create projects, send build requests, read project analytics, and publish projects in the signed-in Lovable workspace. Each user signs in to their own Lovable account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my Lovable projects and when each one was last changed.
Start a new project for a simple habit tracker with a login page.
In my landing page project, add a pricing section with three plans.

apps.name: Lovable
apps.description: Project creation, build requests, and analytics, over Lovable's MCP server with browser sign-in.
